FN-FMPY5DD-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 131
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/21/2024
Senate Bill 131 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Behavior Analyst
Licensing Board within the Division of Developmental Disabilities of the Department of Mental
Health until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
This bill would increase the obligations of the Department of Mental Health by an
undetermined amount dependent on the costs to provide to the Board financial, legal and
information technology services, dedicated office space, and dedicated personnel and office
supplies necessary to operate the Board.

FN-FMPY5DD-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 131
Committee: ENACTED Sponsor: Senator Will Barfoot
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 06/10/2024
Senate Bill 131 (Act 2024-235) as enacted provides for the continuance of the Alabama
Behavior Analyst Licensing Board within the Division of Developmental Disabilities of the
Department of Mental Health until October 1, 2026 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law.
In addition, the provisions of this act will increase the obligations of the Department of Mental
Health by an undetermined amount dependent on the costs to provide to the Board financial,
legal and information technology services, dedicated office space, and dedicated personnel and
office furniture and supplies necessary to operate the Board, as required by the provisions of this
act.
